Department of Earned Importance · Official scoring charter

Every small step. An unreasonable amount of credit.

These tables and formulas are generated from the same versioned rules used by the scoring service. Each run keeps the edition under which it began.

Rules: enterprise-v2 · Manifest: 45c0dddb · Return to the office · Machine-readable rules

AccountingTemporary boostsHeist custodyBadgesProcedural workPublicationNumerical distinctionsCompanionsExtraordinary operationsOffice literacyAchievementsCompletion dividend

The account belongs to completed work

Net points = earned points − stolen points + recovered points + completion dividend. All amounts are exact integers. Recovery is a transfer of your own property, not fresh earnings. Only heists subtract points; no balance goes below zero.

Repeated appointments pay in full. Replays, duplicate receipts, repainting, repeated clicks and elapsed waiting do not. Cached runs pay for actual cache and reuse work, new disclosures and appointments; they invent no manufacturing history. Reveal-all pays for the same completed work as individual disclosure. Missing evidence is marked partial and never fabricated.

Every new mandate starts at zero. A stopped or abandoned run retains its net earnings but receives no completion dividend. The browser retains the latest and previous run and a bounded badge cabinet. Ordinary refresh preserves these records; full data reset clears them. Legacy portfolios retain their original rates.

Number grouping follows your browser locale. No large integer is converted to a floating-point number, abbreviated, or silently rounded.

Temporary executive powers

Normal scoring is ×1. Milestones count newly disclosed lines in this run, not the magnitude of the starting number. The strongest matching grant begins on the following cycle; grants never stack, refresh or queue.

Completed-line milestoneFactorFollowing number cycles
Every 5,000×101
Every 1,000×54
Every 500×310
Every 250×220

A cycle means one newly disclosed number. Pause and room reorganization consume no cycles. Each cycle and its naturally triggered incident retain their captured factor, including delayed receipts. Ending the run discards unused cycles. Incidents cannot extend a boost window.

Cycle scope: procedural work associated with that number, publication, numerical distinctions and appointment salary/supplements. Incident scope: the incident’s pilot or culprit rarity factor multiplied by its triggering cycle factor. Flat scope: entrance grants, manual reorganizations, literacy, achievement grants and completion dividends. Administrative work outside a cycle uses ×1. Theft and recovery are never multiplied.

The appointment formula below includes paired appointments, first identities and loyalty supplements. An indicator is one when eligible and zero otherwise. Paired appointments count once; every 10th appointment of the same identity earns the loyalty supplement. Every repeated Legendary or Mythic appointment receives its entrance grant again. Moving a companion or joining an incident is not another appointment.

The Great Rubber-Stamp Heist: custody of your points

The opening balance is captured before the incident’s own rewards. The fixed at-risk budget is floor((opening score × 800) ÷ 10,000). The chase has 3 active seconds of grace and ends after 15 active seconds. During grace no points are stolen.

At elapsed time in milliseconds: floor((budget × min(12,000, max(0, (elapsed ms − 3,000)))) ÷ 12,000).

A correct interception or amnesty biscuit stops further theft. Recovery is 100% through 4 seconds, then declines to a minimum 10% at 14 seconds. Successful intervention before the end always receives at least this minimum. The automatic ending recovers zero.

Exact recovery in basis points: min(10,000, max(1,000, (10,000 − floor((9 × max(0, (elapsed ms − 4,000))) ÷ 10)))). Points returned: min(stolen, ceil((stolen × recovery basis points) ÷ 10,000)). Round upward to a whole point, never above the amount stolen.

Worked case: opening score 150,000, fixed budget 12,000.

The last row is automatic resolution. Grace begins only once controls are visible and ready. Pause, reorganization, a hidden tab, or obscured intervention controls freezes the financial clock without resetting grace. Wrong accusations do not accelerate theft or reset time. Disabling future incidents does not dismiss an active chase. Skip or abandonment settles accrued losses with no recovery; no unseen theft continues. Recovery earns no multipliers or achievement income.

Natural heists retain a limit of 3 per run. Rehearsals have no scoring effect. Escape legs and handoffs earn no positive points. Automatic return may earn actual closure work, never player-interception points.

Flight and relocation conditions

Natural flights have no run quota and no test-flight control. Flight awards count only completed logical maneuvers. Expediting does not invent skipped folds, checkpoints or loops. Final fan policies pay once each; repeated adjustments do not create awards. Successful delivery includes a ground courier. Reduced motion preserves equivalent completed work.

Reorganization starts with 1 scoring warrant; each 100 disclosed lines earns another. A completed scored move consumes one. An aborted move consumes none. Moves remain available without warrants but earn no points. Manual moves always use ×1. The whole operation pauses during relocation; the resumption award requires actual subsequent progress. Repeated moves cannot multiply an incident’s one resumption award.

Receipt integrity

A logical action is paid once within its run, cycle or incident. A summary cannot duplicate its component work; an independent certification can earn its own award. Administrative facts, animations and narrative retention are separate. The ledger retains bounded aggregates and recent receipts, so a long run cannot require an endless animation log. Scores record rules identity, execution conditions and completion status for future high-score comparisons.
